name: 2027 Canada Games Qualifier (Mixed Doubles)
description:
Location: Re/Max Centre, St. John's

Athlete Eligibility 2-person Mixed Doubles Curling: Athletes must be 21 years old or younger on June 30, 2027. Therefore, athletes born on or after July 1, 2005, are eligible.
